findings.text: non-blocking: the fragment says the shared claim directory means "one sweep of that directory covers a review claim left by a dead dispatcher exactly as it covers a node claim left by one", but no sweep reclaims claim records at all: reckon/crew/gc.py:876 only matches exec-identity filenames, and the only other reader of that directory, reckon/crew/promotion.py:3870, releases claims of a discarded run. Both kinds are in fact reclaimed lazily by the next dispatch through _read_node_dispatch_claim and _reclaim_stale_node_dispatch_claim; the reader benefit of sharing the directory is real, the sweep stated here is not

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from af562db738 to 2f79c541c9: 8d2ea44036 moves the claim into the shared claim directory and onto the owner's readers/reclaimers/atomic writer, aaa12aa153 counts reviews on disk, 8295d313f4 and 2f79c541c9 restate the arms in the evidence fragment
item_verdicts.done_when: all three named cases are implemented in tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py and pass at the repair head (3 passed in 7.26s, EXIT=0), and the base arm falsifies the concurrent case (1 failed, 2 deselected, EXIT=1)
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is one review per delivered head and review kind; reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4406 puts every non-plan, non-dry dispatch under _take_review_head_claim, and the four repair commits carry that claim onto the shared owner helpers without changing what it arbitrates
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the four repair commits, the suites (58 passed base, 61 passed head), the gate arms, the three negative-control logs and the outside-scope attribution of the eight setup errors
item_verdicts.write_paths: the five paths s49 declares; the four gained commits touch only reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py and the section's evidence fragment

VERDICT goal: the goal is that concurrent dispatchers create exactly one review per delivered head and review kind; reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4406 takes _take_review_head_claim in _dispatch_composed_review for every non-plan, non-dry dispatch, and the gained commits keep that key while moving the claim onto the shared helpers.
VERDICT done_when: the three cases s49 names are implemented in tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py and pass at the repair head (3 passed in 7.26s, EXIT=0), with the base arm red on the concurrent case (1 failed, 2 deselected in 3.03s, EXIT=1).
VERDICT write_paths: the five declared paths; the four gained commits touch only reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py and docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-one-delivered-head-gets-one-review.html.
VERDICT manifest: read; it names the four repair commits, the base and head suite arms (58 passed / 61 passed), the gate arms (1 failed, 279 passed base; 1 failed, 281 passed, 8 errors head) and the negative-control logs at logs/negative-control.log and logs/nc-shared-writer.log.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from af562db738 to 2f79c541c9; 8d2ea44036 takes REVIEW_CLAIM_LABEL_PREFIX under NODE_DISPATCH_CLAIM_DIRECTORY and reuses _read_node_dispatch_claim, _empty_claim_is_stale, _reclaim_stale_node_dispatch_claim and write_json_atomically, aaa12aa153 counts run directories on disk, 8295d313f4 and 2f79c541c9 record the measured arms.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4406, reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:4560, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:3418, reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:1742, reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:1328, reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5244

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4406 routes every review-kind dispatch through the (run, head, kind) claim, so one head receives one review of each kind wherever the dispatch enters.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the three cases run as separate interpreters and are logged at logs/repair-node-test.log, and the base arm the previous review asked for is now measured at logs/repair-base-concurrent-node.log (8 errors in 2.27s, EXIT=1).
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in af562db738..2f79c541c9 is one of the five paths s49 declares; s49.html and the figure directory are untouched.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_one_delivered_head_gets_one_review.py:329 asserts the on-disk run directories number one, which reddens on the base revision and on the launcher variant logged at logs/nc-assertion-current.log (3 failed in 6.56s).
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the review claim now follows the naming and helper idiom of reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:720, and no symbol carries a plan or ticket label.
SCORE reuse: 16
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:4628 reuses the claim directory, the attempt bound and the shared reader/reclaimer/writer from reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py, though its reclaim loop remains a parallel copy of _claim_node_dispatch's.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-one-delivered-head-gets-one-review.html:27 non-blocking: the fragment claims one sweep of the shared claim directory covers a stale review claim as it covers a stale node claim, but reckon/crew/gc.py:876 only matches exec-identity filenames and no sweep reclaims claim records; both kinds are reclaimed lazily by the next dispatch, so the stated sweep does not exist.
